item.title: President Lee meets Trump at G7, asks him to "lead resolution of North Korea issue" (이 대통령, G7서 트럼프 만나 “북한문제 해결 주도해달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung attended the welcoming event for invited countries at the Group of Seven (G7) summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, on the 16th (local time) and exchanged greetings with President Donald Trump. (이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 초청국 환영행사에 참석해 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 인사를 나눴다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung stated, "President Lee greeted President Trump during the G7 group photo session," adding, "President Trump asked President Lee about the current state of inter-Korean relations, and President Lee requested that President Trump take the lead in peacefully resolving the North Korean issue, just as he resolved the Middle East conflict." Kang reported that President Trump responded positively, expressing his intention to "work towards resolving the North Korea issue." <<> Upon President Lee's arrival at the welcoming event, French President Emmanuel Macron, who was waiting, approached him, shook hands, and embraced him. President Lee smiled and said, "I'm so happy." President Lee spoke with President Donald Trump for about 40 seconds before the leaders took the group photo. <<> President Lee held separate bilateral talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the sidelines of the G7 summit. President Lee told Chancellor Merz, "I believe Germany and the Republic of Korea can cooperate in many areas and create synergies through collaboration." Chancellor Merz responded, "The Republic of Korea is highly regarded in Germany, and the cooperation so far has been progressing well. I plan to visit Korea at the end of October and hope to see you again then." <<> In his meeting with Prime Minister Carney, President Lee said, "Since there is much we can cooperate on, let's discuss today what specific collaborations we can pursue." Notably, as South Korea is participating in the bid for Canada's next-generation submarine acquisition project, related discussions are likely to have taken place. Prime Minister Carney remarked, "We have strengthened cooperation in various fields, including defense, investment, and culture." <<> Earlier, President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter), "Being invited to the conference for the second consecutive year is a very meaningful event that demonstrates the international community's trust and expectations toward the Republic of Korea." He added, "I plan to engage in in-depth discussions with leaders from G7 member countries and other invited nations on key agenda items of the era, such as international solidarity, growth for all, and the direction of development for artificial intelligence (AI) and future technologies." <<> Évian/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 강유정 수석대변인은 “이 대통령은 주요 7개국 정상회의 단체촬영 과정에서 트럼프 대통령과 만나 인사를 나눴다”며 “트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령에게 남북관계의 근황을 물었고, 이재명 대통령은 트럼프 대통령이 중동 전쟁을 해결한 것처럼 북한문제의 평화적 해결을 주도해 달라고 요청했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “북한문제의 해결을 위해 노력하겠다”는 의사를 밝히며 화답했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. )

item.title: President Lee: "Korea Was a Recipient of Aid"... Proposes New Direction for Development Cooperation at G7 (이 대통령 “한국은 원조받던 나라”… G7서 개발협력 새 방향 제시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung attended the first session of the Group of Seven (G7) summit on the 16th (local time) and stated, "Based on the experience and capacity of growing from a 'recipient of aid' to a 'donor nation,' the South Korean government will fulfill its responsibilities and roles in building international partnerships." (이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 첫 세션에 참석해 “대한민국 정부는 ‘원조받던 나라’에서 ‘원조하는 나라’로 성장한 경험과 역량을 바탕으로, 국제 파트너십을 구축해 나가는 데 나름의 책임과 역할을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee participated in the first expanded session of the G7 summit, titled "Building New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity," held in Évian-les-Bains, France. He discussed with attending leaders ways to enhance the self-reliance capacity of recipient countries—those receiving development aid—through development cooperation, as well as develop mutually beneficial partnerships between recipient and donor nations. The session included leaders from the seven member countries and five invited nations, including India, Brazil, Kenya, and Egypt. The President of the World Bank (WB) and the President of the African Development Bank (AfDB) also attended. ( 이 대통령은 이날 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 확대회의 첫 세션인 ‘새로운 파트너십 구축과 국제연대 재건’에 참석해 참석한 정상들과 개발협력을 통해 개발원조를 받는 수원국의 자립 역량 제고와 수원국과 공여국간 상호 호혜적인 파트너십 발전 방안에 대해 논의했다. 이번 회의에는 주요 7개국 회원국과 인도, 브라질, 케냐, 이집트 등 5개국 초청국 정상 등이 참석했다. 세계은행(WB) 총재와 아프리카개발은행(AfDB) 총재도 참석했다.)

President Lee noted, "Although the AI revolution presents new challenges and opportunities for human growth, many developing countries still lack sufficient access to these opportunities." He emphasized a new partnership where aid, investment, technology, and institutions move in unison, proposing three directions. ( 이 대통령은 “인공지능 혁명은 인류의 새로운 도전이자 성장의 기회임에도 불구, 많은 개도국들이 이러한 기회에 충분히 접근하지 못하고 있다”며 원조와 투자, 기술과 제도가 함께 움직이는 새로운 파트너십을 강조하며 세 가지 방향을 제시했다. )

First, President Lee stated, "Amid shrinking budgets for development aid to underdeveloped countries, we must open new paths for growth in recipient countries through private investment." He added, "To achieve this, private investment and domestic resources of partner countries must be mobilized together, with public funds playing a role in facilitating this." President Lee further said, "We must support recipient countries so that technological gaps between nations do not lead to growth gaps. It is paramount to share the outcomes of AI technological advancements with all nations of the world and grow together." To this end, South Korea has presented a vision of a "Global AI Basic Society," where the benefits of AI technology development are shared by all humanity. ( 먼저 이 대통령은 “저개발국에 대한 개발 원조 예산이 축소되는 상황에서 민간투자를 통해 수원국(원조 수혜국)에게 새로운 성장의 길을 열어줘야 한다”며 “이를 위해 민간 투자와 파트너국의 국내 재원이 함께 동원되어야 하며, 공적 재원은 이를 촉진하는 역할을 수행해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “각국의 기술 격차가 성장 격차로 연결되지 않도록 수원국들을 지원해야 한다면서, 인공지능(AI)의 기술 발전에 따른 결과물을 모든 세계 국가와 공유하고 함께 성장하는 것이 무엇보다 중요하다”고 덧붙였다. 이를 위해 대한민국은 인공지능 기술 발전의 혜택을 모든 인류가 함께 누리는 ‘글로벌 인공지능 기본사회’ 비전을 제시했다. )

Additionally, President Lee emphasized, "The success of development cooperation depends not only on the scale of resources invested but also on how much the lives of people in recipient countries actually change. For this, we must maximize the practical effectiveness of development cooperation." ( 아울러 이 대통령은 “개발 협력의 성과는 투입된 재원의 규모뿐만 아니라 수원국 국민의 삶이 실제로 얼마나 변화하는지에 달려있다면서 이를 위해 개발 협력의 실질적 효과를 최대한 제고해야 한다”고 강조했다. )

Meanwhile, France, the chair of the G7, adopted three documents after the session: "Mutually Beneficial International Partnerships," "Fighting Cancer," and "Responding to Ebola." South Korea expressed support for these documents, reaffirming solidarity with the G7 and key partner countries in the areas of development cooperation and health security. ( 한편 주요 7개국(G7) 의장국인 프랑스는 이날 세션 종료 후 ‘상호 호혜적 국제파트너십', ‘암 퇴치', ‘에볼라 대응' 등 3개 문서를 채택했다. 한국도 이들 문서에 대한 지지를 표명하며 개발협력과 보건안보 분야에서 주요 7개국 및 주요 파트너국들과의 연대를 재확인했다.)

Évian/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 에비앙/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [On-site] The 'Hefei Model' of China's High-Tech Rise: Four Key Words ([현장] 중국 첨단기술 굴기 ‘허페이 모델’의 4가지 열쇳말)
item.description:
Orange robotic arms moved busily, effortlessly lifting car bodies and welding non-stop with bursts of sparks. On the floor, white transport robots scurried about carrying automotive parts. Human workers were seen only very rarely. (주황색 로봇팔들이 부지런히 움직이며 차체를 가뿐하게 들어올리고 불꽃을 튀기며 쉼 없이 용접을 한다. 바닥에서는 흰색 운반용 로봇이 자동차용 부품을 나르느라 분주하다. 인간 노동자의 모습은 아주 가끔 보일 뿐이었다.)

At the F2 factory of NIO (Chinese name: Weilai), a Chinese premium electric vehicle brand located in the Xinqiao NEO Park in Hefei, Anhui Province, visited on the 12th, robots and artificial intelligence (AI) are used to produce one electric vehicle per minute. Completed assembly vehicles move autonomously to self-inspect over 1,000 functions through their internal systems. Approximately 1,300 production robots and over 500 transport robots are 'at work'. A company official stated, "An internet network is installed underground in the factory to collect 1.5 terabytes (TB) of process data daily," adding, "The goal is to automate even decision-making in the future." <<> This state-of-the-art factory, expanding with the aim of becoming the 'world's largest electric vehicle production base', is one of the places showcasing Hefei's transformation into a high-tech city. As a central inland city in China, Hefei was once an 'underdeveloped metropolis' called a 'huge rural village' until about a decade ago. However, strategic investments led by the Hefei city government, combined with the central government's 'Yangtze River Delta Integration' strategy (a collaborative development strategy encompassing Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, championed by President Xi Jinping in 2018), have borne fruit, resulting in explosive growth. In the first quarter of this year, Hefei grew by approximately 6.8% year-on-year, ranking first in growth rate among China's 29 major cities. <<> Just as Shenzhen in southern Guangdong Province leaped forward in the 1980s as a capitalist laboratory and symbol of reform and opening-up—capturing attention with its 'Shenzhen speed' and 'Shenzhen model'—the 'Hefei speed' and 'Hefei model' now symbolize a new path for the Chinese economy. While the Shenzhen model represented private-led growth amid reform, opening-up, and globalization, the Hefei model showcases China's new strategy in an era of security where globalization is ending, amid the high-stakes high-tech competition between the U.S. and China. <<> The first key word is the government's pivotal role. Hefei City operates five investment funds under its jurisdiction, including Hefei Industry Investment and Singtai Capital. In 2008, it temporarily halted subway construction and poured one-third of local fiscal revenue to attract BOE, a display company that was then running losses of over 1 billion yuan. BOE is now the world's largest display manufacturer, ranking first globally in LCDs and second in OLEDs. In 2013, it secured a 37% stake through massive investment in semiconductor company CXMT (Changxin Memory Technologies). Subsequently, as the U.S. imposed semiconductor sanctions on China, 'semiconductor self-reliance' became a core national task, and CXMT grew into a representative Chinese semiconductor company. <<> Going a step further, Hefei City invested 7 billion yuan in 2020 in NIO, an electric vehicle company then on the verge of bankruptcy, to attract its headquarters and production factory. This prompted BYD, Volkswagen, and others to establish electric vehicle factories there. Battery companies also grew alongside, forming a major ecosystem for the electric vehicle industry. Lu Xiaomei, Deputy Director of Hefei City's Foreign Affairs Office, said, "As Hefei's government investments all succeeded, leading to rapid development of its high-tech industries, many people call Hefei a 'gambling city' and pay attention to 'Hefei speed'." She added, "Hefei's success is not gambling; every investment was meticulously examined against development strategies and carefully studied." This refers to investments made according to a core strategic blueprint—'Xinpingqihe', meaning manufacturing development integrating semiconductors, displays, automobiles, and AI. <<> <<> The second key word is talent. At the campus of the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), located in Hefei's northern old city center on the 12th, students were bustling even late at night, and buildings remained brightly lit. Entry is only possible after facial recognition identity verification at the main gate. This place is a hub for China's next-generation future industry research, including AI, quantum technology, nuclear fusion energy, aerospace, semiconductors, and brain-computer interfaces (BCI). <<> USTC, originally based in Beijing, sought a refuge in the 1970s to escape the chaos of the Cultural Revolution. Hefei City provided the best land in the city for its campus and closely cooperated by establishing national-level laboratories. In 2022, they jointly created a science and technology special zone called the 'USTC Silicon Valley'. According to a report by Xinjingbao, about 30% of USTC graduates remain in Hefei each year to start businesses or work, serving as a talent pool for the innovation ecosystem. <<> iFLYTEK, one of the world's leading AI voice recognition companies, also originated in 1999 from the Speech and Language Communication Laboratory of USTC. It was founded by Liu Qingfeng, then a doctoral student at USTC, along with fellow researchers. In iFLYTEK's Chinese name 'Keda Xunfei', 'Keda' refers to USTC. <<> The third key word is the supply chain ecosystem. With the formation of a massive supply chain ecosystem centered on electric vehicles, including solar power and batteries, a 'forest of high-tech industries' is being created, encompassing robots, drones, and energy storage systems (ESS). <<> Gotion High-tech, established in 2006, has grown into a leading Chinese battery manufacturer, ranking fifth globally in battery installations as of the first quarter, with a battery shipment volume of 30GWh, thanks to Hefei City's battery industry nurturing and R&D support. An official from Gotion High-tech's headquarters, met on the 11th, explained that Germany's Volkswagen invested approximately 1.1 billion euros for a 24-25% stake, and the company is equipped with everything from the battery raw material supply chain to energy storage systems. Sungrow, which started with solar inverters founded by former Hefei University of Technology professor Cao Renxian, has transformed into a comprehensive energy solution provider for wind, solar, and energy storage. <<> This is also why, in 2024, the Guangzhou-based drone company EHang established Heyi Aviation in Hefei's Luogang Park through a joint venture with Hefei City's state-owned capital platform. On the 11th, Gu Yong, the company's East China regional manager, stated, "We set up the company here considering Hefei City government's investment and support, abundant engineering talent including from USTC, and the supply chain ecosystem including battery and component companies needed for drone development." Luogang Park is a redevelopment of an old airport site, now hosting facilities like Huawei's R&D center and Heyi Aviation's drone test operation facilities, lined up in succession. Heyi Aviation is conducting test flights of autonomous air taxis here, where an impressive sight shows a drone carrying passengers—its propellers spinning rapidly with a whirring roar—forcefully pushing off the ground and soaring to 120 meters in an instant. <<> The development of the battery and drone industries has become the foundation for China to produce the most cost-effective and efficient supply chain for components needed in the humanoid robot industry. The New York Times (NYT) recently reported, "China has completely dominated the robot supply chain. Without China, it's nearly impossible to produce robots." <<> The final key word of the Hefei model is 'technological self-reliance amid U.S.-China technology competition'. At iFLYTEK's headquarters, visited on the 13th, AI products ranging from daily life to industrial applications were on display, including its self-developed AI model Spark, translation devices and earphones capable of interpreting 83 languages, translation glasses, and acoustic detectors for identifying faults in industrial settings. <<> iFLYTEK was placed on the U.S. government's blacklist in 2019 as the U.S.-China trade and technology competition intensified. Although it developed human-expert-level AI voice translation technology in 2018, from the following year it was cut off from receiving U.S.-made AI semiconductors. The U.S. raised concerns about iFLYTEK's technology potentially connecting with the Chinese military and being used for surveillance. In response, iFLYTEK accelerated its AI development using the Ascend chips from Huawei, which was also on the sanctions list. In 2023, in collaboration with Huawei, it launched 'Feixing-1', a computing platform for training large AI models, and is now advancing into developing its own AI and robots. Cheng Qian, head of iFLYTEK's AI translation division, said, "U.S. sanctions forced us down this path. It shows that sanctions cannot stop China's technological development." <<> Amid the intense U.S.-China competition, strategic industries supported by the Chinese government are developing rapidly, and the walls to block the outflow of high technology are rising. Government and corporate officials met in China from the 9th to 13th said that Korea should become a market open to Chinese high-tech products, but almost no one discussed technology cooperation or investment with Korea. Before entering factories, phones had to be covered with anti-photography stickers, and some companies outright refused to take questions. <<> In the era of national strategic industries for seizing high-tech supremacy, Korea's place within China is not easily visible. The reality of Korea becoming a 'market' for infinitely manufactured, highly price-competitive Chinese products and a 'target of containment' in high-tech competition deepens Korea's concerns. <<> Hefei/Nanjing/Park Min-hee Senior Correspondent minggu@hani.co.kr ( 지난 12일 찾은 중국 안후이성 허페이시 신차오 네오파크에 있는 중국 고급 전기차 브랜드 니오(중국명 웨이라이)의 에프(F)2 공장은 로봇과 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 분당 1대꼴로 전기차를 생산한다. 부품 조립을 마친 차량들은 자율주행으로 이동해 차량 내부 시스템으로 1000여가지 기능을 스스로 검사한다. 약 1300대의 생산용 로봇과 500여대의 운송용 로봇이 ‘일하고’ 있다. 회사 관계자는 “공장 지하에는 하루 1.5테라바이트(TB) 분량의 공정 데이터를 수집하는 인터넷망이 설치돼 있다”며 “앞으로 의사 결정까지 자동화하는 것이 목표”라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Next to Trump Introduces Kim Hye-kyung as "My Wife" (트럼프 옆자리 이 대통령, 김혜경 여사 소개하며 “마이 와이프”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung attended a concert and official dinner hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron in Évian-les-Bains on the 16th (local time), alongside spouses of leaders from the Group of Seven (G7) member nations and invited countries. During the dinner, President Lee sat next to President Donald Trump, discussing key mutual interests between the two nations. (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사는 16일(현지시각) 주요 7개국(G7) 회원국과 초청국 정상 내외 등과 함께 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 주최한 음악회와 공식 만찬에 참석했다. 이 대통령은 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 나란히 앉아 양국의 주요 관심사를 논의했다.)

The presidential office stated in a press release that day, "President Lee and Mrs. Kim attended the concert hosted by Macron, enjoying diverse performances by artists and a children's choir." Notably, during a photo session after the concert, President Lee approached President Trump and personally introduced Mrs. Kim, saying "My wife." President Trump warmly shook hands with Mrs. Kim. (청와대는 이날 보도자료를 통해 “이 대통령과 김 여사가 마크롱이 주최한 콘서트에 참석해 아티스트들의 다채로운 연주와 어린이 합창 등을 감상했다”고 밝혔다. 특히 이 대통령은 콘서트가 끝난 뒤 기념촬영 시간에 트럼프 대통령에게 다가가 “마이 와이프”(My wife)라며 김 여사를 직접 소개하기도 했다. 트럼프 대통령은 김 여사와 반갑게 악수를 나누기도 했다.)

After the concert, President Lee and his wife joined the official dinner hosted by President Macron and First Lady Brigitte, interacting with leaders and their spouses from various countries, as well as representatives from international organizations. The presidential office reported that President Lee sat right next to President Trump at dinner, fostering friendship and camaraderie while closely discussing mutual interests. (콘서트가 끝나자 이 대통령 부부는 마크롱 대통령과 브리지트 여사가 주최한 공식 만찬에 참석해 각국 정상 내외 및 국제기구 대표 등과 교류했다. 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령과 만찬 때 바로 옆자리에 앉아 우호와 친목을 도모하고, 긴밀히 상호 관심사를 논의했다고 청와대는 전했다.)

Earlier, President Lee met and exchanged greetings with President Trump during the group photo session of the G7 summit. Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung stated, "President Trump asked President Lee about the current state of inter-Korean relations, and President Lee requested that President Trump lead a peaceful resolution to the North Korean issue, just as he resolved the Middle East war." In response, President Trump expressed his intention to "work toward resolving the North Korean issue," according to Senior Spokesperson Kang. item.title: Lee Jin-sook: "Pizza with a bug, just swap that slice? ... No reason for Jang Dong-hyuk to resign" (이진숙 “벌레 나온 피자, 그 조각만 바꿔주면 되나…장동혁 사퇴 이유 없어”)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, said on the 17th, "The ruling party had an advantage (in the June 3 local and by-elections), and the People Power Party really performed well, but we cannot accept calling this a defeat or a crushing defeat," adding, "There is absolutely no reason for Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk to resign." (이진숙 국민의힘 의원은 17일 “(6·3 지방선거 및 재보궐선거가) 여당이 유리한 상황에서 국민의힘이 정말 선방했는데, 우리 스스로 이걸 패배 또는 참패라고 하는 걸 받아들일 수 없다”며 “장동혁 대표가 사퇴할 이유가 전혀 없다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on YTN Radio's 'Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang' on the same day, she said, "We were told to fight against the Lee Jae-myung regime, so why on earth are people from within calling for Leader Jang to step down? I truly cannot understand it." (그는 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 나와 “이재명 정권하고 싸우라고 했는데 왜 도대체 내부에서 장 대표한테 물러나라고 하는지 도무지 이해할 수가 없다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The lawmaker also compared the shortage of ballots to "pizza with a bug," describing it as "an incident of infringement on voting rights and democracy." She said, "You divide a pizza into 8 slices or 6 slices, and a bug is found in one slice. If the pizza shop owner says he'll just replace that one slice, what would you do? You'd think it's not just that one slice but the whole round pizza that has problems, and you might consider that all the pizzas that shop baked that day are problematic." (이 의원은 또, 투표용지 부족사태를 ‘벌레 나온 피자’에 비유하며 “참정권·민주주의 침탈 사건”이라고 규정했다. 그는 “피자를 8쪽, 6쪽으로 나눠주는데 한쪽에서 벌레가 나왔다. 피자집 주인이 벌레 나온 한 조각만 교체해준다고 한다면 어떻게 하느냐”며 “그 한쪽뿐 아니라 기본적으로 둥그런 전체 피자 모두에 문제가 있는 거라고 생각하고, 그 피자 가게가 그날 구워낸 피자 모두 문제가 있는 걸로 생각할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Lee had participated in the 'Olympic Park Protest' along with lawmaker Na Kyung-won on the 14th. She added, "When Constitutional Court President Moon Hyung-bae ruled that the Board of Audit and Inspection could not conduct job audits on the (National Election Commission), I think this (ballot shortage) situation was already foreseen." (이 의원은 지난 14일 나경원 의원과 함께 ‘올림픽공원 시위’에 참여한 바 있다. 그는 “문형배 헌법재판소장이 (선거관리위원회에 대한) 감사원의 직무감찰을 할 수 없다는 결정을 했을 때 이미 이런 (투표용지 부족) 사태가 예견되지 않았나 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Constitutional Court ruled in February 2005 that the Board of Audit and Inspection's audit of the National Election Commission, an independent constitutional body, over alleged hiring favoritism was unconstitutional. However, it stated that being excluded from the job audit scope should not be misconstrued as immediately granting immunity for corrupt activities. (헌법재판소는 2005년 2월 감사원이 헌법상 독립기구인 중앙선거관리위원회의 채용 특혜 의혹을 감사한 것은 위헌이라고 판단했다. 다만, 감사원의 직무감찰 대상에서 배제된다고 해서 곧바로 부패행위에 대한 성역의 인정으로 호도되어서는 안 된다고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: “Democratic Party Is All Pro-Lee…Factions Will Dissolve with One-Person-One-Vote System” (정청래 “민주당은 모두 친명…1인 1표제로 계파 소멸”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 17th, “If the ‘one-person-one-vote system’ (for delegates and paid members) is implemented, factions within the party will disappear.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 17일 “(대의원-권리당원) ‘1인 1표제’가 시행되면 당내 계파가 소멸될 것”이라고 말했다.)

At a party supreme council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Representative Jung stated, “Party member sovereignty and the one-person-one-vote system are values that no one can deny,” adding, “Members of the National Assembly will focus on their legislative activities without worrying about the approval of factional bosses, and their political futures will be determined by evaluations from party members. Roh Moo-hyun’s dream of raising the banner of party democracy and reform will be realized, and Lee Hae-chan’s dream of advocating for a democratic people’s party will also come true.” The one-person-one-vote system equalizes the voting power of delegates and paid members in party conventions to elect the party leader and supreme council members, a measure that Representative Jung previously pushed through despite internal opposition. <<> Jung continued, “Some media are still obsessing over maliciously dividing us into factions like the Pro-Jung faction and the Pro-Kim Min-seok faction, which I don’t even recognize. Although I oppose and dislike being labeled under any faction, if I had to distinguish, I’d say I’m a party member faction and a reform faction,” adding, “All members of the Democratic Party are pro-Lee (supporting Lee Jae-myung) in wanting the success of the Lee Jae-myung government. In that sense, Democratic Party members and supporters are all party member sovereignty factions and reform factions.” Representative Jung and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok are considered strong candidates for the party leadership in the upcoming party convention on August 17. <<> Regarding President Lee Jae-myung’s overseas trips and schedule for the G7 summit, Representative Jung said, “President Lee’s actions, showing an irreplaceable South Korea on the global stage, will become the dignity and pride of our people,” adding, “As a South Korean citizen, I support President Lee.” <<> Meanwhile, regarding the “ballot shortage incident” in the June 3 local elections, Representative Jung stated, “The total inadequacy and incompetence revealed by the National Election Commission have exploded public distrust in election management and sparked outrage,” adding, “This ballot shortage should be used as a critical opportunity to strengthen our democracy and enhance national sovereignty.” He then targeted the People Power Party, saying, “Just as damaging as the NEC’s inadequacy and incompetence to our democracy is the People Power Party’s anti-constitutional and anti-democratic behavior through baseless election rigging conspiracy theories and refusal to accept election results,” adding, “What is needed now is a thorough investigation, punishment of those responsible, clear measures to prevent recurrence, and fundamental reform plans. Unsettling attempts to stir unnecessary social conflict and confusion for largely political purposes cannot be tolerated.” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “당원주권정당과 1인 1표제는 누구도 부정할 수 없는 가치”라며 “국회의원들은 계파 보스의 눈치를 보지 않고 의정 활동에 전념하고, 당원 평가에 의해 자신의 정치적 진로를 결정하게 된다. 정당 민주와 정당 개혁의 깃발을 올린 노무현의 꿈도 이뤄지고, 민주적 국민정당을 주창했던 이해찬의 꿈도 실현될 것”이라고 말했다. 1인 1표제는 당대표와 최고위원을 뽑는 전당대회에서 대의원과 권리당원의 표 가치를 같게 만드는 것으로, 앞서 정 대표가 당내 반대를 뚫고 관철한 바 있다.)

item.title: Civilian Control Line to be Pushed North by Average 2km… Lifting of Restricted Zone 150 Times the Size of Yeouido Also Pursued (민통선 평균 2㎞ 끌어올린다…‘여의도 150배’ 제한보호구역 해제도 추진)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense plans to push the Civilian Control Line (CCL) northward by an average of about 2km and pursue the lifting of restricted protection zones covering an area 150 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul (approximately 450 sq km) as part of 'deregulation in the defense sector for military-civilian coexistence.' (국방부는 ‘민군상생을 위한 국방 분야 규제 완화’ 차원에서 민간인통제선(민통선)을 평균 2㎞ 가량 북상하고 서울 여의도 150배 규모(약 450㎢)의 제한보호구역 해제를 추진한다.)

Minister of National Defense An Kyu-baek announced on the 17th a military facility regulatory improvement plan containing these measures, stating that adjustments to the CCL would be pursued across border areas starting next year. The CCL is a baseline that controls civilian access in areas adjacent to the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) for military operational purposes. In principle, it is designated within 10km south of the MDL, but there are variations depending on terrain characteristics and operational needs. (안규백 국방부 장관은 17일 이런 내용이 들어간 군사시설 규제개선 대책을 발표해, 내년부터 접경지역 전반에 걸쳐 민통선 조정을 추진한다고 밝혔다. 민통선은 군사분계선(MDL) 인접지역에서 군사 작전상 민간인의 출입을 통제하는 기준선으로, 원칙적으로 군사분계선 이남 10㎞ 이내에 지정돼 있는데 지형 특성과 작전 필요에 따라 편차가 있다.)

Currently, the CCL is set at an average of 8km south of the MDL. After reviewing regional terrain and operational plans, the Ministry determined that the CCL can be adjusted to an average level of 6km. If adjusted this way, the CCL would shift northward by an average of about 2km. (현재 평균적으로 군사분계선 남쪽 8㎞ 지점에 설정돼 있는데, 국방부는 지역별 지형과 작전계획 등을 검토한 결과 민통선을 평균 6㎞ 수준으로 조정할 수 있다고 판단했다. 이렇게 조정하면 민통선이 평균 2㎞가량 북상하게 된다.)

Minister An explained the background of these measures, stating, "To respond to the changed security environment and ensure conditions for the military to focus on its core combat missions, improving regulations on military facilities has become an inevitable choice." He added, "The Ministry of National Defense and our military have devised policies that guarantee the effectiveness of military operations while enhancing the welfare of residents." (안 장관은 “변화된 안보환경에 대응하고 군이 본연의 전투 임무에 집중할 수 있는 여건을 보장하기 위해서는 군사시설 규제개선이 필연적인 선택이 됐다”며 “국방부와 우리 군은 군사작전의 실효성은 보장하면서 주민들의 편익을 증진할 수 있는 정책을 마련했다”고 이런 조처의 배경을 설명했다.)

The Ministry stated that the CCL can be adjusted to an average of about 6km, and the controlled protection zone, 90 times the area of Yeouido in Seoul, is expected to be relaxed to a restricted protection zone. Minister An explained, "We will supplement control measures such as relocating guard posts, installing barbed wire fences, and closed-circuit television (CCTV), and gradually adjust the CCL starting from 2027." (국방부는 민통선은 평균 6㎞ 정도로 조정 가능하며, 서울 여의도 90배 면적의 통제보호구역이 제한보호구역으로 완화될 것으로 예상된다고 밝혔다. 안 장관은 “민통초소 이전, 경계펜스와 폐회로텔레비전(CCTV) 설치 등 통제수단을 보완하여 2027년부터 단계적으로 민통선을 조정하겠다”고 설명했다.)

The Ministry stated that the costs of adjusting the CCL, which were previously borne by local governments, will now be fully covered by the state, as 'special compensation for special sacrifice.' They also said they would collaborate with local governments for the efficient installation, maintenance, and operation of the CCL. (국방부는 기존에 지방정부가 부담하던 민통선 조정 비용은 ‘특별한 희생에 대한 특별한 보상’ 차원에서 전액 국가가 책임지고, 민통선의 효율적인 설치·유지·운영을 위해 지방정부와 협업해 나가겠다고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry announced plans to optimize the restricted protection zone south of the MDL. The restricted protection zone refers to the area south of the CCL within 25km south of the MDL, and currently about 2,900 sq km of land in border regions is designated as such. In restricted zones, prior consultation with the military is mandatory when constructing buildings, imposing development constraints. (국방부는 군사분계선 이남 제한보호구역을 최적화하겠다고 밝혔다. 제한보호구역은 군사분계선 이남 25㎞ 범위 이내의 지역 중 민통선 이남 지역으로, 현재 접경지역 국토의 약 2900㎢가 지정돼 있다. 제한보호구역에선 건축물 신축 때 군과 사전 협의를 의무적으로 거쳐야 하는 등 개발에 제약이 따른다.)

The Ministry explained that it would improve the blanket designation criteria for the restricted protection zone south of the MDL, minimize operational review and management needs for military units, and enable regional development within limits that do not impede military operations. (국방부는 일괄적으로 지정된 군사분계선 이남 제한보호구역 지정기준을 개선해, 군부대의 작전성 검토 및 관리 소요를 최소화하고 군사작전에 지장이 없는 범위 내에서 지역개발이 가능하도록 하겠다고 설명했다.)

It is anticipated that a restricted protection zone 150 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul can be lifted. The total area of protection zones that are lifted or relaxed is expected to be about 240 times the size of Yeouido. (서울 여의도 150배 면적의 제한보호구역을 해제할 수 있을 것으로 예상되며, 해제·완화되는 보호구역의 전체 면적은 여의도 면적의 240배 정도로 예상된다.)

The Ministry stated that starting from the second half of this year, it would sequentially lift protection zones, beginning with areas where preparations are complete through operational reviews and topographical surveys by each unit. Specific regions were not disclosed on this day. A Ministry official explained, "We have a rough idea of the areas on the map, but the specific regions will be determined through military review and administrative procedures." (국방부는 올해 후반기부터 부대별 작전성 검토와 지형측량을 통해 준비가 완료된 곳부터 순차적으로 보호구역을 해제하겠다고 밝혔다. 이날 구체적인 지역은 공개하지 않았다. 국방부 관계자는 “지도상으로 해당 지역을 대략 파악했지만 구체적인 지역은 군사적 검토와 행정 절차를 거쳐 확정될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

The Ministry announced that among military obstacles such as concrete barriers and road rockfall requested for removal by local governments, 23 locations in Paju, Gyeonggi Province, and Yanggu, Gangwon Province, where military utility has decreased due to changes in the operational environment, will be prioritized for removal in 2027. A comprehensive survey will be conducted in the second half of this year to establish an annual improvement plan. (국방부는 지방정부가 철거를 요구한 용치, 도로 낙석 등 군사장애물 중 작전환경 변화로 인해 군사적 효용성이 감소된 경기 파주, 강원 양구 등의 23개소를 2027년에 우선 철거하고, 올 후반기에 전수조사를 통해 연차별 개선계획을 수립하겠다고 밝혔다.)

To improve waiting times for CCL entry and administrative delays, a CCL entry management system utilizing mobile apps and simple authentication will be established starting next year. The Ministry added that it will continue various efforts to resolve inconveniences for border area residents, such as significantly simplifying the approval process for agricultural drone flights in border regions. item.title: ‘Concrete Mounds’ on Air Force Runways Too… Violating Regulations Like in the Jeju Air Disaster (공군 활주로에도 ‘콘크리트 둔덕’…제주항공 참사 때처럼 규정 위반)
item.description:
A Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) audit has revealed that Air Force headquarters-operated airbases also have concrete mound structures installed in violation of regulations. Such concrete structures were identified as a key factor in the December 29, 2024 Jeju Air passenger plane disaster at Muan International Airport in South Jeolla Province. (공군본부가 운영하는 비행기지에도 규정과 다르게 콘크리트 둔덕 구조물이 설치된 것으로 감사원 감사 결과 드러났다. 콘크리트 구조물은 2024년 전남 무안공항에서 일어난 12·29 제주항공 여객기 참사의 결정적 요인으로 꼽힌 바 있다.)

According to the BAI's regular audit of Air Force headquarters released on the 17th, localizer structures installed in the safety zones at the end of runways at five out of six dedicated Air Force airbases were found to be made of reinforced concrete. These structures were installed up to 120 cm above the ground surface. Under the defense and military facility standards established by the Ministry of National Defense, navigation facilities installed more than 7.5 cm above the ground surface must be built with a frangible structure, but this regulation was violated. (감사원이 17일 공개한 공군본부 정기감사 결과를 보면, 공군 전용 비행기지 6곳 중 5개 비행기지에서 활주로 끝부분 안전구역에 설치된 로컬라이저 구조물이 철근 콘크리트 구조물로 설치된 것으로 나타났다. 해당 구조물은 지표면에서 최대 120㎝ 높게 설치돼 있었다. 국방부가 마련한 국방·군사시설 기준상 항행시설물을 지표면에서 7.5㎝ 높게 설치하면 부러지기 쉬운 구조로 설치해야 하는데, 이런 규정을 어긴 것이다.)

The BAI also confirmed that facilities within the runway strip at the five airbases were built with reinforced concrete. The runway strip is a safety area installed around runways to prepare for cases where aircraft veer off the runway. (감사원은 5개 비행기지에 있는 착륙대 내에 있는 시설이 철근 콘크리트로 지어진 것도 확인했다. 착륙대는 비행기가 활주로를 이탈하는 경우에 대비해 활주로 주변에 설치하는 안전지대다.)

The BAI investigated 16 flight accidents that occurred during takeoff and landing of Air Force military aircraft since 2016 and found that 14 were runway excursion accidents caused by fighter jet defects and other issues. This underscores the importance of safety management regarding the materials and structures of facilities installed in runway strips and runways. The BAI notified the Air Force Chief of Staff to prepare measures to install and manage the problematic concrete facilities with a frangible structure. (감사원은 2016년 이후 공군 군용항공기가 이착륙하는 과정에서 일어난 비행사고 16건을 조사한 결과, 전투기 결함 등으로 발생한 활주로 이탈 사고가 14건이었다고 밝혔다. 이 때문에 착륙대와 활주로에 설치되는 시설물의 재질이나 구조에 대한 안전관리가 중요하다. 감사원은 공군참모총장에게 해당 문제가 된 콘크리트 시설물을 부러지기 쉬운 구조로 설치·관리하는 방안을 마련하라고 통보했다.)

Management to prevent bird strikes was also insufficient. Since 2020, 70 to 80 bird strike incidents have occurred annually at Air Force airbases. However, the BAI pointed out that the Air Force has lacked efforts to prevent accidents, including not introducing bird detection radar capable of long-range and high-altitude bird detection since 2014. (항공기와 조류 충돌을 예방하기 위한 관리도 미흡했다. 2020년 이래 공군 비행기지에서는 매해 70∼80건의 조류충돌(버드 스트라이크) 사고가 발생했다. 그러나 감사원은 공군이 2014년을 마지막으로 원거리·고고도 조류 탐지가 가능한 조류탐지레이더를 도입하지 않는 등 사고 예방 노력이 부족하다고 지적했다.)

Problems with inadequate pilot training were also found. An assessment of the adequacy of Air Force pilots' proficiency flights over the four years from 2021 to 2024 showed that out of a total of 12,988 proficiency flights, 3,589 flights had a flight time of less than 30 minutes. The 3,043 pilots who trained this way received 6.7 billion won in proficiency flight allowances. The number of proficiency flights with a flight time of 5 minutes or less was also tallied at 112, with 104 pilots who conducted them receiving 200 million won in proficiency flight allowances. The Air Force pays 260,000 to 740,000 won per month in proficiency flight allowances to pilots who complete at least one proficiency flight per quarter, but the Air Force regulations do not even specify a minimum time for proficiency flights. In contrast, the Army stipulates flights of "30 minutes or more" per quarter and pays allowances accordingly. (부실한 조종사 훈련 문제도 발견됐다. 2021∼2024년 4년간 공군 조종사들의 유지비행 적정성을 점검한 결과, 전체 1만2988번의 유지비행 중 비행시간이 30분 미만에 불과한 비행 횟수는 3589회에 달했다. 이렇게 훈련한 조종사 3043명은 유지비행 수당으로 67억원을 받았다. 비행시간이 5분 이하인 유지비행 횟수도 112회로 집계됐고, 이를 수행한 104명이 2억원의 유지비행 수당을 받았다. 공군은 분기별 1회 이상 유지비행을 한 조종사에 대해선 월 26∼74만원의 유지비행 수당을 지급하는데, 공군 규정상 유지비행의 최소 시간은 규정조차 되지 않았다. 반면 육군은 분기별 ‘30분 이상’ 비행을 하도록 규정하고 그에 따라 수당을 지급한다.)

The Air Force is required to obtain confirmation forms from pilots subject to proficiency flights to verify whether they have conducted them, but due to lack of inspection, 46 pilots who did not conduct proficiency flights from 2021 to the first half of 2025 improperly received 57.29 million won in allowances. (공군은 유지비행 대상 조종사에게 확인서를 제출받아 유지비행 실시 여부를 확인해야 하지만, 이를 점검하지 않아 2021∼2025년 상반기까지 유지비행을 하지 않은 46명이 5729만원을 부당 수급하는 일도 있었다.)

This audit was initiated following a series of recent safety accidents in the Air Force. Last year alone, there were three runway excursion accidents, and in March of the same year, a misfire accident occurred in a civilian residential area in Pocheon, Gyeonggi Province, during a South Korea-U.S. joint exercise. This is the first regular audit of the Air Force headquarters agency by the BAI since 2014. (이번 감사는 최근 공군에서 안전사고 문제가 잇따르면서 시작됐다. 지난해에만 3차례의 활주로 이탈사고가 있었고, 같은 해 3월엔 한-미 연합훈련 기간 경기도 포천시 민간 거주지역에서 오폭 사고가 발생했다. 감사원의 공군본부 기관 정기 감사는 2014년 이후 처음이다.)

Jang Ye-ji Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Sports organizations fume over 'Olympic Park blockade'… Ask Democratic Party to "move ballot boxes" (‘올공 봉쇄’ 속타는 체육단체들…민주당에 “투표함 옮겨달라”)
item.description:
Affiliates of the Korean Olympic & Sports Committee, struggling to prepare for international competitions due to the 'Olympic Park blockade protest,' met with Democratic Party lawmakers to voice grievances and request countermeasures. <<> They met with lawmakers Im O-kyung, Jeon Yong-gi, and Cheon Jun-ho at the Olympic Park Velodrome in Songpa-gu, Seoul on the 17th, pleading that they have been driven to the point of having to give up on participating in international competitions. The Korea Underwater Finswimming Association, which must hold the World Finswimming Championships in Incheon on the 22nd, has been unable to bring out necessary equipment. An association official said, "There are cases of cancellations, and some are asking why they even have to come amid this situation." In fact, the national fencing team departed for the Asian Championships that day without their personal gear due to the aftermath of the protest. A sports organization official said, "Outside (the protesters) just say to sacrifice the small for the greater good." <<> Sports organizations reported that employees are experiencing personal threats and psychological trauma. "Due to severe verbal abuse, the public relations office has taken all phones down," they said. Another official said, "When we gave out business cards, the protesters posted real names and phone numbers on YouTube. If we didn't give business cards, they tracked down Instagram accounts and shut them down." Comments like "Just having a camera causes trauma" and "Even if you show your ID, they claim it's fake" were also made. <<> Sports organizations also expressed strong disappointment with the police. One official said, "We tried to enter trusting the police, but they didn't stop them (the protesters). Now there's no trust in the police, so I told employees to assume they can't get in anymore." The protesters are reportedly sharing full building blueprints and blocking underground passages where people won't go. The Korea Sports Promotion Foundation requested, "To quickly resolve this situation, please move election ballot boxes to a safe zone where supervision can be conducted." <<> After the meeting, lawmaker Jeon Yong-gi told reporters, "The Asian Games are less than 100 days away, but the administrative operations of sports organizations are paralyzed. National athletes are in a dire situation where they can't even wear their uniforms." Lawmaker Cheon Jun-ho said, "This isn't about trying to enter the ballot counting station; it's about requesting cooperation for equipment in the sports committee's activity space. Basic freedom of passage must be guaranteed. Blocking that can only be seen as an illegal act." <<> Inside the Handball Stadium are nine sports organizations under the Korean Olympic & Sports Committee: the Korea Handball Association, Korea Fencing Federation, Korean Alpine Federation, Korea Wushu Association, Korea Sepak Takraw Association, Korea Underwater Finswimming Association, Korea Billiards Federation, Korea DanceSport Federation, and Korea Water Ski & Wake Sports Association. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (‘올림픽공원 봉쇄 시위’로 국제대회 출전 준비에 어려움을 겪고 있는 대한체육회 산하 단체들이 더불어민주당 의원들을 만나 피해를 호소하며 대책 마련을 요청했다.)

item.title: Yoon Sang-hyun of People Power Party to Head Parliamentary Inquiry into Election Commission, Lee Jun-seok Also Participates (‘선관위 국조특위’ 위원장에 국힘 윤상현…이준석도 참여)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun has been appointed as the chair of the "Special Committee on Parliamentary Inquiry into the June 3 Local Elections Ballot Shortage Incident and Violation of Citizens' Voting Rights for Electoral Reform." (윤상현 국민의힘 의원이 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사특별위원회'(국조특위) 위원장을 맡게 됐다.)

PPP Chief Deputy Whip Kim Seung-soo announced on the 17th that five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun (Incheon Dong-gu/Michuhol-gu) has been designated as the chair of the special parliamentary inquiry committee. PPP's secretary for the committee will be lawmaker Seo Beom-soo, who oversees the National Election Commission as the relevant authority, while lawmakers Kim Eun-hye, Park Soo-min, Shin Dong-wook, Joo Jin-woo, and Choi Bo-yoon are set to join as members. (김승수 국민의힘 원내운영수석부대표는 17일 국조특위 위원장에 5선 윤상현 의원(인천 동·미추홀을)이 내정됐다고 밝혔다. 국조특위 국민의힘 간사는 중앙선관위원회를 소관 기관으로 둔 서범수 의원이 맡고, 위원으로 김은혜·박수민·신동욱·주진우·최보윤 의원이 합류할 예정이다.)

In a Facebook post on the same day, Yoon said, "This parliamentary inquiry must not become a battleground for political disputes weighing the pros and cons of specific parties," adding, "I will conduct the investigation based on objective facts and evidence, and thoroughly prepare necessary institutional improvements and legal revisions." (윤 의원은 이날 페이스북에 글을 올려 “이번 국정조사는 특정 정당의 유불리를 따지는 정치 공방의 장이 되어서는 안 된다”며 “객관적 사실과 증거에 기초해 조사를 진행하고, 필요한 제도 개선과 법률 정비 방안까지 충실히 마련하겠다”고 말했다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party has designated its supreme council member, lawmaker Jeong Chun-saeng, as a committee member, while the Reform Party has nominated its leader, lawmaker Lee Jun-seok. Earlier, the Democratic Party of Korea and the PPP agreed to conduct a 45-day parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage incident, with the chair position going to the PPP per parliamentary convention. The committee will consist of nine members from the Democratic Party, seven from the PPP, and one each from the Rebuilding Korea Party and the Reform Party, maintaining equal numbers between the ruling and opposition blocs. (조국혁신당은 최고위원인 정춘생 의원을, 개혁신당은 당 대표인 이준석 의원을 각각 위원으로 내정했다. 앞서, 더불어민주당과 국민의힘은 투표용지 부족 사태 등에 대한 국정조사를 45일간 실시하기로 합의하면서, 위원장은 국회 관례대로 국민의힘이 맡고, 특위 위원은 더불어민주당 9명, 국힘의힘 7명, 조국혁신당과 개혁신당 각 1명 등 여야 동수로 구성하기로 했다.)

Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
The Reform Party stated on the 17th regarding the police investigation results that the incident in which candidate Jung Yi-han (38), who ran in the June 3 Busan mayoral election, was injured while trying to avoid a drink thrown by a man during campaigning was a "staged incident": "The party is also a victim in this matter," and "we will actively cooperate with the investigation to ensure no doubts remain." (개혁신당은 지난 6·3 부산시장 선거에 출마한 정이한(38) 후보가 선거운동 중 한 남성이 던진 음료를 피하려다 부상을 입은 사건이 ‘자작극’이라는 경찰의 수사 결과에 대해 “당 역시 이번 사안의 피해 당사자”라며 “한 치의 의혹도 남지 않도록 수사에 적극 협조하겠다”고 17일 밝혔다.)

Earlier, on the same day, *Weekly Chosun* reported, "The Busan Geumjeong Police Station is investigating candidate Jung Yi-han on charges of obstruction of official duties through deception, spreading false information, and violating the Public Official Election Act." (앞서, 주간조선은 이날 “부산금정경찰서가 정이한 후보를 위계에 의한 공무집행방해와 허위사실 공표, 공직선거법 위반 등의 혐의를 적용해 수사 중”이라고 보도했다.)

At around 8:05 a.m. on April 27, candidate Jung was campaigning by handing out business cards to drivers waiting at a signal near Saejeong Tower in Geumjeong-gu, Busan. According to candidate Jung's side, when a driver threw a beverage from inside the car, Jung tried to dodge it, fell, lost consciousness, and was taken to the hospital. The police arrested the driver, a man in his 30s, at around 2:20 p.m. that day. Jung later visited the man and submitted a plea for leniency, returning to campaigning two days later on the 29th wearing a neck brace. (정 후보는 지난 4월27일 오전 8시5분께 부산 금정구 세정타워 근처 도로에서 신호 대기 중이던 승용차 운전자들에게 명함을 나눠주며 선거운동을 하고 있었다. 당시 정 후보 쪽은 한 운전자가 차 안에 있던 음료수를 뿌리자 정 후보가 이를 피하려다 넘어져 의식을 잃은 채 병원으로 옮겨졌다고 했다. 경찰은 당일 오후 2시20분께 해당 운전자인 30대 남성을 긴급체포했다. 정 후보는 이후 이 남성을 면회하고 선처 탄원서를 제출했으며, 이틀 뒤인 29일 목 보호대를 착용하고 선거운동에 복귀했다.)

The Reform Party stated, "As a result of our check, former candidate Jung had already left the party through the online system," adding, "We are keenly aware that uncovering the truth is directly linked to the party's honor. Once the facts are clearly established, the central party will also take additional necessary civil and criminal measures." (개혁신당은 “확인 결과 정 전 후보는 이미 온라인시스템을 통해 탈당을 한 상태”라며 “진상 규명이 당의 명예와 직결된다는 점을 엄중히 인식하고 있다. 이후 확실하게 사실관계가 파악되면 중앙당에서도 필요한 민·형사상의 조치를 추가 단행할 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun: jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 12 Voters Who Received Waiting Numbers in Jamsil Did Not Vote... Election Commission Admits 'Infringement of Voting Rights' (잠실 대기표 받은 12명 투표 안 해…선관위 쪽 “참정권 침해 맞다”)
item.description:
Cho Hyun-wook, chairman of the Central Election Management Committee's fact-finding committee on the ballot shortage incident, stated on the 17th, "Ultimately, 12 people did not vote (at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, where ballots were insufficient)." (조현욱 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회 위원장이 17일 “(투표용지가 부족했던 서울 송파구 잠실7동 2투표소에서) 최종적으로 12명은 투표를 결국 안 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Appearing on KBS Radio's program "Jeon Gyeok Sisa" that day, Chairman Cho said, "There were 12 people who came to vote but had no ballots, waited, and eventually left without voting," and when the host asked, "So, were these 12 people ultimately deprived of their voting rights?" he responded, "Yes." (조 위원장은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오 ‘전격시사’에 출연해 “투표하러 왔는데 용지가 없었고 기다리다가 결국 돌아가서 못한 게 12명이 있는 것”이라며 ‘12명이 결국 참정권을 침해받은 것이냐’는 진행자 물음에 “그렇다”고 했다.)

On the 3rd, the Songpa-gu Election Commission issued waiting numbers to 175 voters at around 4:46 p.m. at the second polling station in Jamsil 7-dong, after determining that ballots were insufficient. This was a measure to guarantee voting rights for voters who arrived at the polling station by the 6 p.m. deadline. However, when 17 waiting tickets were not returned, the election commission extended voting hours until 10 p.m. Nonetheless, it was found that 12 holders of waiting tickets ultimately did not vote. Regarding this investigation, Chairman Cho said, "Among the 140 locations that requested additional ballots, the key are the 91 that actually used them, and among those, the 26 polling stations where voting was suspended," adding, "We obtained and analyzed the voting logs (detailing the voting situation by time) until yesterday." <<> The number of election petitions filed related to the June 3 local elections, which ended that day, has also surged sharply. As of the 16th, the Central Election Commission reported 96 petitions, and as of the 15th, local election commissions reported 34, totaling at least 130 election petitions. Among these, there are 10 petitions concerning the Seoul mayoral election. Compared to 45 petitions during the 2022 local elections and 11 during the 2018 local elections, this shows a sharp increase. When adding the petitions filed by the People Power Party, the final figure is expected to rise further. <<> Meanwhile, five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun has been internally appointed as the chair of the National Assembly's special committee on parliamentary investigation, "Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation for Fact-Finding and Election Management Reform Regarding the Infringement of Citizens' Voting Rights, Including the June 3 Local Election Ballot Shortage Incident," which the People Power Party will lead. The floor leaders from both parties are Yoon Gun-young of the Democratic Party and Seo Beom-soo of the People Power Party. The ruling and opposition parties plan to pass the parliamentary investigation plan at a plenary session on the 18th. <<> Reporter Ko Kyung-ju goh@hani.co.kr (지난 3일 송파구 선관위는 잠실7동 2투표소에서 투표용지가 부족하다고 판단한 오후 4시46분께 유권자 175명에게 대기번호표를 지급했다. 투표 마감 시간인 오후 6시까지 투표소에 도착한 유권자들의 투표권을 보장하려는 조처였다. 하지만 대기표 17매가 회수되지 않자 선관위는 투표시간을 10시까지 연장했다. 그럼에도 대기표 소지자 12명은 결국 투표하지 않은 것으로 조사됐다. 조 위원장은 이번 조사와 관련해 “추가 투표용지를 요청한 140곳 중 실제로 추가 용지를 사용한 91곳, 그중에서도 투표 중단이 일어났던 26개 투표소가 핵심”이라며 “어제까지 (투표 상황을 시간대별로 기록한) 투표록을 입수해 분석했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Joins 'Future Innovation Forum' Led by Pro-Yoon Faction — Prelude to Rejoining the People Power Party? (한동훈, 친윤 주축 ‘미래혁신포럼’ 가입…국힘 복당 사전 작업?)
item.description:
Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon has joined a parliamentary study group originally led by the pro-Yoon (Yoon Suk-yeol) faction. This move is interpreted as a preliminary step toward his return to the People Power Party (PPP). (무소속 한동훈 의원이 옛 친윤(윤석열)계 주축의 국회의원 연구모임에 합류했다. 한 의원이 국민의힘 복당 사전 작업에 나서는 것이란 해석이 나온다.)

A forum official said on the 17th that Han joined the 'Korea Future Innovation Forum' on the 16th, which is chaired by PPP lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun. The forum had asked newly elected lawmakers about their interest in joining, and Han expressed his intention, earning full membership. (한 의원이 16일 김기현 국민의힘 의원이 회장을 맡고 있는 ‘대한민국 미래혁신포럼’에 가입했다고 포럼 관계자가 17일 전했다. 포럼에서 새로 원내에 진입한 의원들에게 가입 의사를 물었는데, 한 의원이 가입 의사를 밝히며 정회원 자격이 부여됐다.)

The Future Innovation Forum, with about 30 members, includes many PPP lawmakers such as Na Kyung-won, Yoon Sang-hyun, Kim Jeong-jae, and Lee Man-hee. It also includes Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok and Democratic Party floor leader Han Byeong-do. Although it started as a group with a strong pro-Yoon orientation, it now also includes many pro-Han members like Seo Beom-soo, Woo Jae-joon, and Han Ji-ah. (의원 30여명으로 구성된 미래혁신포럼은 나경원·윤상현·김정재·이만희 등 국민의힘 의원들이 다수 소속돼 있다. 이준석 개혁신당 대표와 한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표 등도 회원이다. 친윤계 색채가 강한 모임으로 시작됐지만, 현재는 서범수·우재준·한지아 등 친한동훈계 의원들도 다수 참여한다.)

Han's membership is seen as a strategic move to expand his contacts within the PPP before rejoining the party. Since being expelled from the PPP in January last year, Han has repeatedly expressed his desire to rejoin after winning a by-election in Busan's Buk-gu. A pro-Yoon lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh*, "For Han to return, he needs to shift the mood among lawmakers, so he's probably trying to establish a foothold first." Attention is also focused on whether Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, a key conservative figure, will speak at the forum on the 24th, potentially bringing together major conservative contenders. (한 의원의 모임 가입은 복당 전 국민의힘 인사들과 접점을 넓히려는 포석으로 풀이된다. 지난해 1월 국민의힘에서 제명된 한 의원은 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 당선된 이후 거듭 복당 의사를 밝혀왔다. 한 친윤계 의원은 한겨레에 “한 의원이 복당하려면 의원들 분위기 반전이 필요한데 우선 접점부터 만들어보려는 게 아니겠나”라고 했다. 이 포럼에 오는 24일 오세훈 서울시장이 연사로 나서면서, 보수 유력 주자들이 한데 모이는 자리가 마련될지에도 관심이 쏠린다.)

Jang Na-rae, reporter wing@hani.co.kr Yoo Young-jae, reporter young@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] PPP caucus agrees to file election petitions for 7 local governments, delivers stance to Jang Dong-hyuk ([속보] 국힘 의총서 ‘광역단체 7곳 선거소청’ 뜻 모아 장동혁에 전달)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) held a general meeting of its lawmakers at the National Assembly main building on the afternoon of the 17th and reached a consensus among its members on the need to file election petitions for seven local governments (Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, Jeonnam-Gwangju, and Chungbuk) where issues such as ballot shortages occurred in the June 3 local elections. Choi Eun-seok, the PPP’s senior deputy floor spokesman, stated, “The majority of lawmakers who attended the caucus conveyed to Representative Jang Dong-hyuk their opinion that it would be advisable to file election petitions limited to those seven regions.” (국민의힘이 17일 오후 국회 본청에서 의원총회를 열고 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 문제가 발생한 광역단체 7곳(서울·경기·인천·부산·울산·전남광주·충북) 선거 소청을 제기해야 한다는 방향으로 의원들의 뜻을 모았다. 최은석 국민의힘 원내수석대변인은 “의원총회에 참석한 의원들 다수는 일곱 곳에 제한적으로 선거소청하는 게 바람직하다는 의견을 장동혁 대표에게 전달했다”고 말했다.)

item.title: "Honey, They Say He's the Ferrari Chairman"… Mrs. Kim Hye-kyung's "I Want to Try It" Draws Laughter at the State Banquet (“여보, 페라리 회장님이래”…김혜경 여사 “타보고 싶다”에 만찬장 웃음)
item.description:
Mrs. Kim Hye-kyung, who accompanied President Lee Jae-myung on his overseas trip, met Ferrari Chairman John Elkann at the Italian state banquet and burst into laughter, saying "It's (a car) I like." (이재명 대통령의 순방에 동행한 김혜경 여사가 이탈리아 국빈 만찬장에서 존 엘칸 페라리 회장을 만나 “제가 좋아하는 (차)”라며 웃음을 터뜨렸다.)

According to a video titled "6-Night, 7-Day Italy Log" released on President Lee's YouTube channel on the 17th (local time), the President conversed with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and Ferrari Chairman John Elkann at a state banquet hosted by Italian President Sergio Mattarella on the 11th (local time). Chairman Lee introduced Elkann to the President as "a friend of 25 years" and "the head of a company that owns Fiat, Chrysler, Peugeot, etc." (17일(현지시각) 이 대통령의 유튜브 채널에 공개된 ‘6박 7일 이탈리아 로그’ 영상을 보면, 이 대통령은 지난 11일(현지시각) 세르지오 마타렐라 이탈리아 대통령이 주최한 국빈 만찬에서 이재용 삼성전자 회장, 존 엘칸 페라리 회장 등과 대화를 나눴다. 이 회장은 엘칸 회장을 가리키며 “25년 된 친구”라며 “피아트와 크라이슬러, 푸조 등을 보유한 회사”라고 이 대통령에게 소개했다.)

At this, President Lee called out to Mrs. Kim, saying, "Honey, they say he's the chairman who manufactures Ferraris." Mrs. Kim replied, "It's an honor to meet you. I'd love to try one myself," prompting laughter on the spot. (그러자 이 대통령은 김 여사를 부르며 “여보, 페라리를 제조하는 회장님이시래”라고 말했다. 김 여사는 “만나 뵙게 돼 영광이다. 저도 한 번 타보고 싶다”라고 말해 현장에서 웃음이 터졌다.)

President Lee returns home on the 17th after completing his 8-night, 10-day European tour, ending with the expanded session of the Group of Seven (G7) summit. (이 대통령은 17일 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 확대회의 일정 등을 끝으로 8박10일간의 유럽 순방을 마치고 귀국한다.)

item.title: NEC Fact-Finding Committee: Roh Tae-ak Only Learned of 50% Ballot Reduction Guidelines After Incident (선관위 진상규명위 “노태악, 투표지 50% 축소인쇄지침 사태 이후 인지”)
item.description:
<<>> Former National Election Commission (NEC) Chairman Roh Tae-ak was found to have been unaware of the decision to reduce ballot printing rates, which caused the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, until after the incident. Investigations revealed that Roh only learned of the existence of the printing reduction guidelines after the ballot shortage occurred. ()

Jo Hyeon-uk, head of the NEC's Fact-Finding Committee on the ballot shortage, held the 6th meeting on the 17th and stated in a briefing, "Through written responses from the NEC chairman, standing commissioner, secretary-general, and deputy secretary-general, we confirmed whether the NEC was informed during the dissemination of the '50% ballot reduction guidelines' and whether reports and responses were made on election day regarding the situation." He added, "Regarding the 'reduction in the number of ballots printed on election day' (50% lower limit), the NEC chairman responded that he had not been briefed before the guidelines were implemented." He further noted, "Former Chairman Roh stated that he only learned of the existence of the ballot reduction guidelines after the incident occurred." ( 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원회 위원장이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태의 원인이 된 투표용지 인쇄비율 축소 결정을 사전에 인지하지 못했던 것으로 드러났다. 노 전 위원장은 인쇄비율 축소 지침의 존재를 투표용지 부족사태가 벌어진 뒤에서야 알게 된 것으로 조사됐다. )

Previously, on December 10 of last year, the NEC revised the comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide local elections under the authority of the secretary-general. The guidelines included a clause stating, "If a reduction in the number of ballots printed on election day is deemed necessary based on expected early voting rates and voter turnout in recent elections, it can be adjusted by a commission resolution to a lower limit of 50% of the number of voters." This reduced the lower limit for ballot printing from 60% to 50%, which became the root cause of the ballot shortage on the 3rd. ( 조현욱 중앙선거관리위원회 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명위원회 위원장은 17일 제6차 회의를 연 뒤 브리핑을 통해 “중앙선관위 위원장, 상임위원, 사무총장, 사무차장의 서면질의서 회신을 통해 ‘(투표용지) 50% 축소인쇄 지침’ 시달과정에서 중앙선관위의 보고 여부, 본투표 당일 사태에 대한 보고 및 대응 여부를 확인했다”며 “‘선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수 축소’(50% 하한)에 대하여 중앙선관위 위원장은 지침 시행 전에 보고받은 바가 없다고 회신했다”고 밝혔다. 이어 “(노 전) 중앙선관위 위원장은 이번 사태 발생 후에 투표용지 인쇄축소 지침의 존재를 알게 됐다고 한다”고 덧붙였다. )

It was also revealed that former Chairman Roh only learned of the ballot shortage on election day through media reports. Chairman Jo stated, "The NEC learned of the ballot shortage not through a report from the Seoul Election Commission but via media reports, and simultaneously received reports from the standing commissioner and secretary-general." He added, "Around 5:08 PM on that day, they became aware of the ballot shortage and considered issuing ballots through ballot dispensing machines, but it was already too late for an appropriate response." Chairman Jo further added that the Seoul Election Commission's decision to extend voting hours until 10 PM was not reported to former Chairman Roh in advance. ( 앞서 중앙선관위는 지난해 12월10일 ‘사무총장 전결’로 제9회 전국동시지방선거 종합관리지침을 개정했다. 해당 지침에는 “선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수는 예상 사전투표율 및 최근 선거의 투표율 등을 감안하여 축소인쇄 필요성이 인정되는 경우 위원회 의결로 선거인수 50%(하한)를 기준으로 조정 가능하다”는 대목이 들어갔다. 이에 따라 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한은 기존 60%에서 50%로 줄었다. 이는 지난 3일 투표용지 부족 사태의 근본적 원인이 됐다. )

Chairman Jo said, "Given that the NEC did not receive prior reports from the Songpa-gu Election Commission or the Seoul Election Commission about the ballot shortage, it is clear that the rapid reporting and response system for emergency situations was not functioning." ( 노 전 위원장이 선거 당일 투표용지 부족사태를 언론 보도를 통해서야 알게 된 것도 드러났다. 조 위원장은 “중앙선관위는 투표용지 부족사태를 서울시 선관위로부터 보고 받은 게 아니라 언론보도를 통해 알게 됐고 그와 동시에 상임위원, 사무총장 등으로 보고를 받았다고 한다”며 “당일 오후 5시8분 무렵 투표용지 부족 사안을 인지하고 투표용지 발급기를 통한 발급 등을 검토했지만 이미 너무 늦어 적절한 대처가 되지 못했다”고 했다. 아울러, 서울시 선관위가 오후 10시까지 투표 시간을 연장한 결정도 노 전 위원장은 사전에 보고받지 못했던 것으로 확인됐다고 조 위원장은 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 조 위원장은 “투표용지 부족상황에 대해 중앙선관위가 송파구 선관위, 서울시 선관위로부터 사전 보고를 받지 못한 점을 볼 때 비상상황에 대한 신속한 보고·대응 체계가 미작동함을 알 수 있었다”고 밝혔다. )

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae to Attend President Lee’s Homecoming Event…Will the ‘Lee-Jung Conflict’ Be Mended? (이 대통령 귀국 행사에 정청래 참석…‘명-청 갈등’ 봉합될까)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok are set to attend the welcoming ceremony for President Lee Jae-myung’s return on the 18th after concluding his European tour. This is seen as an attempt by the presidential office to patch up the deepening internal strife within the ruling camp, known as the ‘Lee-Jung conflict,’ which has been fueling controversy. (유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 복귀하는 이재명 대통령의 귀국 환영 행사에 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 김민석 국무총리 등이 참석한다. ‘명-청 갈등’으로 불리는 여권 내 내홍이 깊어지고 이로 인한 논란도 확산하자 청와대가 일단 봉합에 나선 것으로 풀이된다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung announced to the media on the 17th, “Tomorrow’s welcome event for President Lee’s return will be attended by government officials including the Prime Minister and the Vice Minister of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, as well as the party leadership including the party leader and the floor leader of the Democratic Party.” Earlier, at the send-off event for President Lee’s overseas trip on the 9th, only Prime Minister Kim attended, while the ruling party leadership, including leader Jung, were absent at the direction of the presidential office. At the time, the presidential office explained that “the number of attendees was minimized in consideration of domestic circumstances, such as the prolonged Middle East war and the poor management by the National Election Commission.” However, political circles interpreted this as a deliberate exclusion of leader Jung. Following President Lee’s public criticism of the ruling party leadership, including leader Jung, during his first-year anniversary press conference on the 8th, many viewed Jung’s unprecedented exclusion from the send-off event the next day as President Lee’s way of backing Prime Minister Kim over leader Jung, who is mentioned as a potential candidate for the August 17 party convention. (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 17일 언론 공지를 내어 “내일 이 대통령 귀국 환영 행사에는 국무총리, 행정안전부 차관 등 정부 인사와 당대표, 원내대표 등 민주당 지도부가 참석할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 앞서 지난 9일 이 대통령 순방 환송 행사 때는 김 총리만 참석하고 정 대표 등 여당 지도부는 청와대 뜻으로 불참한 바 있다. 당시 청와대는 “중동 전쟁 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등 국내 상황을 염두에 둬 환송 인원을 최소화했다”고 설명했지만, 정치권에서는 의도적인 정 대표 배제란 해석이 나왔다. 이 대통령이 지난 8일 취임 1년 기자회견에서 정 대표 등 여당 지도부를 공개 비판한 데 이어, 이튿날 정 대표가 이례적으로 환송 행사 참석 명단에서 제외된 것을 두고 이 대통령이 8·17 전당대회 주자로 거론되는 정 대표와 김 총리 가운데 김 총리에게 힘을 실어준 것이란 시각이 많았다.)

Within and outside the Democratic Party, there is a prevailing view that while tensions between the party and the presidential office have temporarily eased, the behind-the-scenes maneuvering over leader Jung’s potential candidacy for the party convention will continue. At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Jung stated, “(This year’s party convention) will be the first to implement a one-person-one-vote system,” adding that “the one-person-one-vote system will lead to the dissolution of factions within the party.” This remark, re-emphasizing the abolition of weighted votes for delegates and equalizing the value of votes between delegates and paid party members, is seen as targeting party sentiment with an eye on running for the party leadership. At the meeting, Jung dismissed the distinction between ‘pro-Lee’ and ‘pro-Jung’ factions, or ‘pro-Jung’ and ‘pro-Seok’ (pro-Kim Min-seok) factions, calling it “malicious divisiveness,” and said, “If I must categorize myself, I am a member of the party’s reformist faction.” Within the party, there is growing weight behind the prediction that if Jung finalizes his intention to run, he will resign as party leader on the 24th, two days before the scheduled formation of the party convention preparatory committee, and officially declare his bid for re-election. (민주당 안팎에선 당-청 간 긴장이 일시적으로 완화됐으나 정 대표의 전당대회 출마 여부를 둘러싼 여권 내 신경전은 계속될 거란 관측이 지배적이다. 정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “(올해 전당대회는) 1인 1표제로 시행되는 첫 전당대회”라며 “1인 1표제로 당내 계파가 소멸할 것”이라고 말했다. 당대표와 최고위원 선거에서 대의원 표에 부여되던 가중치를 폐지하고 대의원과 권리당원의 표 가치를 동등하게 하는 1인 1표제를 다시 강조한 것으로, 전당대회 출마를 염두에 두고 당심을 겨냥한 발언으로 읽힌다. 정 대표는 이 자리에서 ‘친명’(친이재명), ‘친청’(친정청래) 구분 또는 ‘친청’, ‘친석’(친김민석) 구분에 대해 “악의적 갈라치기”라며 “저는 굳이 구분한다면 당원파고 개혁파”라고 했다. 당내에선 정 대표가 최종 출마 의지를 굳힐 경우 전당대회준비위원회 구성 예정일 이틀 전인 오는 24일 대표직에서 사퇴하고 연임 도전을 공식화할 거란 전망에 무게가 실린다.)

At the same meeting, figures within the party who have been at odds with Jung also targeted him. Supreme Council member Kang Deuk-gu, who is close to Prime Minister Kim, remarked, “If a losing soccer manager and coaching staff write the match evaluation (the white paper on the June 3 local elections), who would trust the results? Party members are eternal, but party power is finite.” This was a direct retort to Jung’s message from the Supreme Council meeting on the 10th, where he said, “The people are eternal, and the government is short-lived,” a comment interpreted at the time as an indirect jab at President Lee. (정 대표와 각을 세워온 당내 인사들은 이날 회의에서도 정 대표를 겨냥했다. 김 총리와 가까운 강득구 최고위원은 “축구 경기에서 패배한 감독과 코치진이 경기 평가서(6·3 지방선거 평가 백서)를 직접 작성한다면 누가 그 결과를 신뢰하겠나”라며 “당원은 영원하지만 당권은 유한하다”고 말했다. 지난 10일 정 대표가 최고위원회의에서 한 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”는 메시지를 정 대표에게 고스란히 되돌려준 것이다. 당시 정 대표의 발언은 이 대통령을 에둘러 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다.)

It is also noteworthy that figures who had not taken sides in the conflict between the pro-power and anti-power factions are now calling on Jung not to run. Lawmaker Ki-heon Lee wrote on Facebook, “If the party convention held in the first year of the administration sees the party and government in conflict or competition, the momentum for governance over the next four years will inevitably be severely damaged. Jung should not run, and a stable management of the party convention must be ensured.” Lawmaker Seong-jun Jin appeared on YTN Radio the previous day and stated, “I don’t think Jung has much justification to challenge for re-election.” (당권파와 비당권파의 갈등 전선에 서지 않던 인사들까지 정 대표 불출마 요구에 나선 점도 주목된다. 이기헌 의원은 페이스북에 “집권 1년차에 맞이한 전당대회에서 당과 정부가 갈등하거나 경쟁하는 모습을 보인다면 향후 4년간 국정 운영의 동력은 심각하게 훼손될 수밖에 없다”며 “정 대표의 불출마와 함께 안정적인 전당대회 관리가 이뤄져야 한다”고 했다. 진성준 의원은 전날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오에 나와 “정 대표가 연임에 도전할 만한 명분은 많지 않다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Prime Minister Kim, who is considered a de facto candidate for the party convention, carried out schedules in the Honam region that day, including attending the Yeosu offshore wind power supply chain conference and exhibition and the completion ceremony for the electric furnace at POSCO’s Gwangyang Steelworks. A re-elected lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area commented, “If we enter a ‘my-way’ competition just over a year into the administration ahead of the party convention, it will be like carrying a time bomb even after the convention ends. If the rift deepens further from here, the public will say, ‘We entrusted them with power, and they’re just fighting among themselves.’” (한편 전당대회 출마를 기정사실로 한 김 총리는 이날에도 전남 여수 해상풍력 공급망 콘퍼런스 전시회와 포스코 광양제철소 전기로 준공식에 참석하는 등 호남 일정을 소화했다. 한 수도권 재선 의원은 “집권 1년을 겨우 지난 시점에서 전당대회를 앞두고 ‘마이웨이’식 경쟁에 들어가면 전당대회가 끝나도 시한폭탄을 안고 가는 상황이 될 것”이라며 “여기서 더 갈등의 골이 깊어지면 국민은 권력을 맡겼더니 자기들끼리 싸우기나 하는구나 할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae "Everyone is pro-Myung" vs. Jang Dong-hyuk "Full Re-election"… Wavering Commanders [Gongdeok-Pocha] (정청래 “모두 친명” vs 장동혁 “전면 재선거”… 흔들리는 사령탑들[공덕포차])
item.description:
<<>> ()

Ahead of the August 17 party convention, Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, has opted for a frontal breakthrough. At the Supreme Council meeting on the 17th, Representative Jung expressed displeasure, stating, "The talk of pro-Cheong and pro-Seok factions is malicious division," and declared, "Everyone in the Democratic Party is pro-Myung, wishing for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." The logic is that since everyone is pro-Myung, factional divisions are inherently fictitious. However, criticism is emerging that blaming the media is somewhat far-fetched, given that Jung’s own remark, "The regime is short," sparked the Myung-Cheong conflict theory. ()

Regarding the key pledge of the one-person-one-vote system, he emphasized, "If implemented, intra-party factions will disappear." Yet, given the reality that one-third of paid party members are concentrated in the Honam region, there is considerable counterargument that instead of factions vanishing, the situation will merely transform into a 'battle for party members' votes'. ( 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 정면돌파에 나섰습니다. 정 대표는 17일 최고위원회의에서 “친청파·친석파 운운은 악의적 갈라치기”라고 불쾌감을 드러내며, “민주당 모두는 이재명 정부의 성공을 바라는 친명”이라고 선언했습니다. 모두가 친명이니 계파 구분 자체가 허구라는 논리입니다. 다만 ‘정권은 짧다’는 정 대표 본인의 발언이 명·청 갈등설을 촉발했던 만큼, 책임을 언론에 돌리는 화법은 다소 무리가 있다는 지적이 나옵니다.)

The pressure is intense. In the 210,000-member 'Jaemyeong's Village,' a signature drive is underway calling for Representative Jung’s resignation and refusal to run for re-election. The conflict between Kwak Sang-eon and Yoo Si-min over the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation has also spilled over into clashes among supporters. On the opposing side, an alliance between Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Democratic Party lawmaker Song Young-gil, who have simultaneously launched campaigns in Honam, is emerging. ( 핵심 공약인 1인1표제를 두고는 “시행되면 당내 계파가 소멸된다”고 강조했습니다. 그러나 권리당원의 3분의1이 호남에 몰린 현실에서, 계파가 사라지기보다 ‘당원 표심 쟁탈전’으로 모습만 바뀐다는 반론도 만만치 않습니다. )

The most painful aspect is the approval rating. President Yoon's negative job performance rating has surpassed the positive rating for the first time since his inauguration, and in party support, the People Power Party has overtaken the Democratic Party for the first time. Even the achievements of the overseas trips have been overshadowed. The moment one declares there are no factions, the cost is directly billed as a drop in approval ratings. ( 압박은 거셉니다. 21만명 규모의 ‘재명이네마을’에서 정 대표 사퇴·연임 불출마 서명운동이 진행되고, 노무현재단을 둘러싼 곽상언·유시민 갈등으로 지지층 충돌까지 번졌습니다. 맞은편에는 호남에 동시 출격한 김민석 국무총리와 송영길 민주당 의원의 연합설이 떠오르고 있습니다. )

Is Representative Jung Cheong-rae’s frontal breakthrough truly a message of 'unity,' or is it an alibi for 'holding out'? Is Jang Dong-hyuk, the leader of the People Power Party, who, despite warnings from local elections, stood at the forefront of re-election and ballot-counting protests, building a platform for consolidation, or is it a tactic to cover up the responsibility for defeat? Let's find out on 'Gongdeok-Pocha.' Check out the video! ( 가장 뼈아픈 대목은 지지율입니다. 이 대통령 국정 부정평가가 취임 후 처음으로 긍정평가를 추월했고, 정당 지지도 역시 국민의힘이 처음으로 민주당을 역전했습니다. 순방 성과마저 묻혔습니다. 계파는 없다고 외치는 순간에도, 그 비용은 고스란히 지지율 하락으로 청구되고 있습니다.)

item.title: President Lee and Trump Engage in Two-Hour Close Communication… Discuss Korea-US Alliance, Middle East Situation and Other Current Issues (이 대통령-트럼프 2시간 밀착 소통…한미동맹, 중동정세 등 현안 논의)
item.description:
<<>> The presidential office announced on the 17th that President Lee Jae-myung had a close exchange of opinions with US President Donald Trump on major issues including the Korea-US alliance, the Middle East situation, and the Korean Peninsula issue during the official dinner of the Group of Seven (G7) summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France on the 16th (local time). ()

President Lee met with President Trump at the official dinner hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife, congratulating him on the conclusion of ceasefire negotiations between the US and Iran. The two agreed on the importance of free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and shared expectations that the restoration of stability and peace in the Middle East would stabilize oil prices and revive the economy. President Lee reportedly had a conversation with President Trump, who was seated right next to him, for about two hours. ( 이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 공식 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 한-미 동맹, 중동 정세 및 한반도 문제를 포함한 주요 현안에 대해 긴밀한 의견을 교환했다고 청와대가 17일 밝혔다. )

President Lee also asked President Trump to pay attention to peace on the Korean Peninsula. In response, President Trump expressed a strong willingness to play a necessary role in advancing the Korean Peninsula issue and stated that he would consider ways to contribute to peace on the Korean Peninsula, according to the presidential office. President Trump also expressed his intention to communicate closely with President Lee regarding peace on the Korean Peninsula. ( 이 대통령은 이날 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령 부부가 주최한 공식 만찬에서 트럼프 대통령과 만나 미-이란 간 종전 협상이 타결된 것을 축하했다. 호르무즈해협 내 자유롭고 안전한 항행의 중요성에 대해서 의견을 같이하고, 중동 지역 내 안정과 평화가 회복됨으로써 유가가 안정되고 경제가 회복될 것이란 기대도 함께 나눴다. 이 대통령은 이날 트럼프 대통령의 바로 옆자리에서 2시간가량 대화를 나눴다고 한다. )

The two leaders exchanged views on expanding mutually beneficial cooperation in areas such as shipbuilding and shared consensus on the importance of trilateral cooperation between South Korea, the United States, and Japan based on a solid Korea-US alliance. President Trump evaluated President Lee as a 'strong leader' and expressed expectations that the two leaders would together contribute to peace and security on the Korean Peninsula, the presidential office added. ( 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령에게 한반도 평화를 위해 관심을 기울여줄 것을 주문하기도 했다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 한반도 문제 진전을 위해 필요한 역할을 해 나가겠다는 강력한 의지를 표명하고, 한반도 평화를 위한 기여 방안에 대해 고민하겠다고 밝혔다고 청와대는 전했다. 트럼프 대통령은 한반도 평화와 관련해 이 대통령과 긴밀히 소통해 나가겠다는 뜻도 함께 밝혔다. )

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 두 정상은 조선 분야 등에서의 호혜적 협력 확대 방안에 대해 의견을 교환하고, 굳건한 한-미 동맹을 토대로 한 한·미·일 협력의 중요성에 대해서도 공감대를 나타냈다. 트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령을 ‘강한 지도자’로 평가하며 양 정상이 함께 한반도 평화와 안보에 기여해나갈 수 있을 거라는 기대감을 표명했다고 청와대는 덧붙였다. )

item.title: ‘Jung Eui-han staged attack suspicion’ Reform Party: “Already left party sneakily… will respond without leniency” (‘정이한 피습 자작극 의혹’ 개혁신당 “이미 꼼수 탈당…무관용 대응”)
item.description:
The Reform Party has announced that it will take stern measures against Jung Eui-han, the Busan mayoral candidate for the June 3 local elections, who is under investigation over suspicions that his attack during a campaign rally was staged, stating that he has already “sneakily left the party.” <<> Cheon Ha-ram, the Reform Party’s floor leader, posted on Facebook on the 17th, saying: “As the chair of the nomination committee responsible for the party’s local election nominations, I feel a deep sense of responsibility and dismay over the controversy and behavior of former Busan mayoral candidate Jung Eui-han, who has shown extremely irresponsible attitudes such as abruptly leaving the party and cutting off contact,” and apologized, saying “I sincerely apologize for causing concern to the public and party members over this unfortunate incident.” <<> Floor leader Cheon stated: “Former candidate Jung submitted a resignation from the party abruptly using the online system to avoid the party’s condemnation and strict punishment for his wrongdoing” and called it “a cowardly ‘sneaky withdrawal’ exploiting the fact that party withdrawal takes immediate effect under the Party Act.” He added: “The Reform Party makes it clear that just because he has left physically, the wrongdoing does not disappear,” and announced that the party would △launch its own fact-finding team △take legal action without leniency △and impose a permanent ban on rejoining the party. <<> Earlier that day, the Weekly Chosun reported: “The Busan Geumjeong Police Station is investigating former candidate Jung Eui-han on charges of obstructing official duties by deception, publishing false information, and violating the Public Official Election Act.” <<> Candidate Jung, who ran for Busan mayor under the Reform Party, was campaigning on April 27 at around 8:05 a.m., handing out business cards to drivers waiting at a traffic light on a road near Sejeong Tower in Geumjeong-gu, Busan. At the time, Jung’s side claimed that a driver sprayed beverages from his car, causing Jung to fall while trying to avoid it and lose consciousness, after which he was taken to the hospital. Police arrested the driver, a man in his 30s, at around 2:20 p.m. that day. Later, Jung visited the man and submitted a leniency petition, and two days later, on the 29th, he returned to campaigning wearing a neck brace. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (개혁신당은 유세 중 피습 사건과 관련해 자작극 의혹으로 수사를 받고 있는 정이한 6·3지방선거 부산시장 후보가 이미 ‘꼼수 탈당’을 했다며 엄중 조처하겠다고 밝혔다.)
